headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 3, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing an 8-0 victory. Wenceel Pérez led the Tigers' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Jack Flaherty earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 6 and allowing 0 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Matt Gage (San Francisco Giants) has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right knee inflammation. Rob Zastryzny (Milwaukee Brewers) has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a left trapezius strain. Nick Sogard (Boston Red Sox) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right oblique strain. Jonathan Heasley (Tampa Bay Rays) has been placed on the 15-day injured list, and Braden Shewmake (Houston Astros) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right adductor strain.

Several trades and roster moves have been made. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Tigers Shut Out Rays 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing an 8-0 victory. Wenceel Pérez led the Tigers' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Jack Flaherty earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 6 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres dropped a 2-3 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Phillies' pitching staff.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 4-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Shane Baz earning the win after 7.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Nationals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Heriberto Hernández leading the charge at the plate. Hernández hit two home runs, including a key homer that scored Jakob Marsee, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Nationals 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with standout performances from Xavier Edwards, Esteury Ruiz, and Joe Mack on offense. Max Meyer led the pitching effort for the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Rays 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 7-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, marking a strong performance for the team. Impact hitters for the Tigers included Riley Greene and Jake Rogers, while Cedric Mullins led the Rays' offense.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Matt Gage on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants left-handed pitcher Matt Gage has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right knee inflammation, effective retroactive to June 2, 2026.

top_news.title: **Justin Lawrence Traded to Minnesota Twins**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins acquired right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash on June 2, 2026.
